english_version.publisher: Agency for Communication Networks and Services (AKOS)
english_version.note: No English text in the stored files. One web search found no English translation of the act; AKOS has English web pages that describe the allocation of supervision under the act (lead only, not a translation, not stored), and law-firm and tracker summaries (CMS, Morrison Foerster, regulations.ai).

title.source_quote: Zakon o izvajanju uredbe (EU) o določitvi harmoniziranih pravil o umetni inteligenci (ZIUDHPUI)
title.why: The gazette writes 'uredbe' in lower case in the title (contents line, promulgation decree and every reference in issue 85/2025); original_title has 'Uredbe'. Only the government news release capitalises it. Otherwise identical. The English 'Act Implementing the Regulation (EU) laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence' is accurate; it uses the EU's own English wording for the regulation.

summary_claims.claim: AKOS is the coordinating market surveillance authority for most Annex I and III areas and Article 50.
summary_claims.original_quote: Agencija je pristojna za nadzor nad skladnostjo visokotveganih sistemov UI, urejenih z zakonodajo Unije iz oddelka A Priloge I Uredbe 2024/1689/EU, z zahtevami Uredbe 2024/1689/EU, nad skladnostjo visokotveganih sistemov UI iz 2. in 4. točke ter pod (a) in (d) 5. točke Priloge III
summary_claims.literal_translation: The Agency is competent to supervise the compliance of high-risk AI systems governed by the Union legislation in Section A of Annex I of Regulation 2024/1689/EU with the requirements of Regulation 2024/1689/EU, the compliance of high-risk AI systems in points 2 and 4 and under (a) and (d) of point 5 of Annex III

summary_claims.claim: The Information Commissioner supervises the Article 5 prohibitions.
summary_claims.original_quote: (1) Informacijski pooblaščenec je pristojen za nadzor nad določbami 5. člena Uredbe 2024/1689/EU in nad skladnostjo visokotveganih sistemov UI iz 1. in 3. ter 6. do 8. točke Priloge III Uredbe 2024/1689/EU z zahtevami Uredbe 2024/1689/EU.
summary_claims.literal_translation: (1) The Information Commissioner is competent to supervise the provisions of Article 5 of Regulation 2024/1689/EU and the compliance of high-risk AI systems in points 1 and 3 and 6 to 8 of Annex III of Regulation 2024/1689/EU with the requirements of Regulation 2024/1689/EU.

summary_claims.original_quote: se ponudnik ali uvajalec, ki je pravna oseba, samostojni podjetnik posameznik ali posameznik, ki samostojno opravlja dejavnost, kaznuje z globo v višini do 35.000.000 eurov ali do sedem odstotkov skupnega svetovnega letnega prometa za preteklo poslovno leto, odvisno od tega, kateri znesek je višji.
summary_claims.literal_translation: the provider or deployer that is a legal person, sole trader or self-employed individual is punished with a fine of up to EUR 35,000,000 or up to seven percent of total worldwide annual turnover for the preceding financial year, whichever is higher.

key_terms.note: Literally 'the ministry responsible for the market' (Article 3(1), notifying authority for most Annex I Section A products). The Government's release (secondary.html) calls it the ministry responsible for the economy ('ministrstva, pristojna za gospodarstvo'). 'ministry responsible for the economy (market)' would be closer than 'trade'.

key_terms.original: organ za nadzor trga; priglasitveni organ
key_terms.note: These are the Slovenian-language terms of Regulation 2024/1689 itself; the register uses the Regulation's English terms.

key_terms.original: Nacionalni svet za etiko v umetni inteligenci
key_terms.register_rendering: National Council for Ethics in AI
key_terms.note: Literal (Article 23). Five members, five-year mandate, appointed by the Government.

issues: The summary gives AKOS 'most Annex I and III areas' and the Information Commissioner only the Article 5 prohibitions. Article 10 gives AKOS all of Annex I Section A but only Annex III points 2, 4, 5(a) and 5(d) (plus Article 50); the Information Commissioner supervises Article 5 and Annex III points 1, 3, 6, 7 and 8 (biometrics, education, law enforcement, migration, administration of justice). The summary misstates which body supervises most Annex III high-risk areas.
'ministries for trade' renders 'ministrstvo, pristojno za trg' (ministry responsible for the market); the Government release names the economy ministry.
original_title capitalises 'Uredbe'; the gazette title has 'uredbe'.
note: Also checked against the stored text: AKOS as single point of contact (Art. 7), coordinator of the market-surveillance coordination council (Art. 15), sandbox authority (Art. 17), keeper of the record of Annex III point 2 high-risk systems (Art. 18) and entry point for SMEs (Art. 19); the Bank of Slovenia, the Insurance Supervision Agency and the Market Inspectorate for credit and insurance (Art. 10(2)-(4)); the accreditation body assessing conformity assessment bodies (Art. 5, which names the function, not 'Slovenian Accreditation'); adoption 23 October 2025, promulgation 31 October 2025, entry into force on the fifteenth day after publication (Art. 45). All match.
